QuestScriptGenerator
After a grammar file uxml is read. All the existing terminal definitions are parsed and added to each GrammarTerminal. Then for each terminal definition, a corresponding MonoBehaviour script is generated to be used as a QuestTrigger in the UnityScene. UnityEngine.MonoBehaviours are autogenerated to keep the same GrammarFields as the terminal definition, and to be used as QuestTriggers.
